assertion.hypotheses: The chosen good-reduction comparison prime p permits specialization; the composite has the same source and target, and ell differs from p.
assertion.quantifiers: For each good comparison prime p of this original beta family, its actual reduction endomorphism e_p, and each coefficient prime ell different from p.
assertion.parameter_range: Arbitrary ground field and rational endomorphism; denominators may first be cleared.

assertion.statement: The original beta r_5 is the Tate realization of the selected primitive weight-two form.
assertion.objects: For the D6 beta family only: The original r_5 from the rational scalar descent construction and the final primitive normalized weight-two form f.
assertion.hypotheses: The finite B-linear isogeny choices and scalar cochain satisfy the exact descent identity; full End=B and the actual Tate restriction supply irreducibility, de Rham weights and oddness.
assertion.quantifiers: The fixed original five-adic factor and its fixed coefficient embedding.
assertion.parameter_range: The direct published prime-five theorem with its verified geometric inputs; arbitrary final nebentypus and coefficient field.
assertion.uniformity: The finite twist is absorbed into the final form while A, the controlled cochain, L-prime and the original representations are retained.
assertion.constants: The final weight is 2 and Tate normalization has weights 0,-1. No numerical bound on the modular level is obtained here.
assertion.normalizations: Use t=a/eta. Select the primitive source before forcing weight two; the final finite character is distinct from chi=eta^2.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No good reduction at 5 or residual small-image condition is inserted. Weight-one finite image is excluded by the nonzero Hodge-Tate weight.
assertion.limit_order: Establish the direct five-adic hypotheses, apply modularity, then primitive decomposition, weight comparison and the determinant finite twist.
